image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rough, grey rocky surface. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The lighting highlights the glossy texture of the plates and the granular texture of the surrounding rock.
